technique_name: List ways to improve the user experience when buying online.
description: There are several ways to improve the online user experience when shopping. One is to make the shopping process as streamlined and frictionless as possible by minimizing the number of steps required. Make sure checkout forms are simple and easy to understand, with clear labels and instructions. Provide helpful customer service such as FAQs and chatbot support to help customers should they have any questions. Additionally, ensure that customers have access to the payment options that they prefer.
